Workflow.Name: FIM Create Service Account
Workflow.Definition:
"@@ConnectionString: ''
@@Type: 'Local'
@@DesktopType: 'local'
@@DisplayName: 'Local computer'
IMPORT 'controlRepo.appmask' AS appmask
IMPORT 'imageRepo.imgrepo' AS imgrepo
@SENSITIVE: []
@INPUT varFIMDataJSON : { 'Description': 'Add FIM Data in JSON string format', 'FriendlyName': 'varFIMDataJSON', 'Type': 'String', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': '''{
 \"RequestedAccountName\": \"RPA0247001\",
 \"RequestedName\": \"Pega Request Intake\",
 \"FirstName\": \"RPA0247001\",
 \"LastName\": \"Syriac\",
 \"AccountOwner\": \"Christy Syriac\",
 \"Location\": \"IND Bengaluru - Technology Campus\"
}''' } 
@INPUT varLogPath : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'varLogPath', 'Type': 'String', 'IsOptional': True, 'DefaultValue': 'E:\\RPA\\ARGO_FIM\\Error' } 
@OUTPUT varIsSuccess : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'varIsSuccess', 'Type': 'String' } 
SET varFlowError TO $'''false'''
BLOCK 'Error Handling'
ON BLOCK ERROR all
 SET varFlowError TO $'''true'''
END
 **REGION User Menu Navigation
 Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: varFIMDataJSON CustomObject=> JsonAsCustomObject
 WebAutomation.LaunchEdge.LaunchEdge Url: $'''https://myprofile.bdx.com/IdentityManagement/default.aspx''' WindowState: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowState.Maximized ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 Timeout: 60 PiPUserDataFolderMode: WebAutomation.PiPUserDataFolderModeEnum.AutomaticProfile TargetDesktop: $'''{\"DisplayName\":\"Local computer\",\"Route\":{\"ServerType\":\"Local\",\"ServerAddress\":\"\"},\"DesktopType\":\"local\"}''' BrowserInstance=> Browser
 WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... fault.aspx\'']['Button \'Users\''])
 @@copilotNextBestAction: 'True'
WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... fault.aspx\'']['Button \'Users\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Button \'New\''])
 @@copilotNextBestAction: 'True'
WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Button \'New\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 **ENDREGION
 **REGION Disclaimer Tab
 WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Span \'Create User\''])
 @@copilotNextBestAction: 'True'
WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Checkbox \'Disclaimer\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 @@copilotNextBestAction: 'True'
WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Button \'Next >\' Disclaimer'] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 **ENDREGION
 **REGION General Tab
 WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Label \'Training / Test / Service Accounts\''])
 @@copilotNextBestAction: 'True'
WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Checkbox \'General\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Button \'Next >\' General'] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 **ENDREGION
 **REGION Generic Account Form
 WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Span \'Account Type* ... used for*\''])
 WebAutomation.SetDropDownListValue.SetDropDownListValueByName BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Selection \'Account Type\''] OptionNames: $'''Service Account''' UseRegularExpression: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input text \'Requested Account Name\''] Text: JsonAsCustomObject['RequestedAccountName'] Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace EmulateTyping: False UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input text \'First Name\''] Text: JsonAsCustomObject['FirstName'] Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace EmulateTyping: False UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input text \'Last Name\''] Text: JsonAsCustomObject['LastName'] Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace EmulateTyping: False UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input text \'Account Manager\''] Text: JsonAsCustomObject['AccountOwner'] Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace EmulateTyping: False UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 @@copilotNextBestAction: 'True'
WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input image \'Validate Account Manager\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WAIT 1
 WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input text \'Description\''] Text: $'''Service Account for %JsonAsCustomObject['RequestedAccountName']% - %JsonAsCustomObject['RequestedName']%''' Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace EmulateTyping: False UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input text \'Location\''] Text: JsonAsCustomObject['Location'] Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace EmulateTyping: False UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input image \'Validate Location\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WAIT 1
 WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input text \'Justification\''] Text: $'''Service account required for bot to access Portal''' Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace EmulateTyping: False UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Input text \'Application\''] Text: $'''Portal''' Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace EmulateTyping: False UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 @@copilotNextBestAction: 'True'
WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Button \'Next >\' Generic'] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 **ENDREGION
 **REGION Submission & Summary
 WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Table \'Attr ... e TypeUser\''])
 @@copilotNextBestAction: 'True'
WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Button \'Submit\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Span \'SummaryThe ... approval.[Details]\''])
 WebAutomation.Focus.Focus BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Button \'OK\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
 WebAutomation.Click.Click BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rsons.aspx\'']['Button \'OK\''] ClickType: WebAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MouseClick: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 MousePositionRelativeToElement: WebAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
 **ENDREGION
 WebAutomation.CloseWebBrowser BrowserInstance: Browser
END
IF varFlowError = $'''true''' THEN
 ERROR => vLogErrorDescription Reset: True
 DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> CurrentDateTime
 Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: CurrentDateTime CustomFormat: $'''yyyy-MM-dd_HHmmss''' Result=> CurrentDateTime
 SET vExceptionScreenshot TO $'''%varLogPath%\\%CurrentDateTime%.jpg'''
 Workstation.TakeScreenshot.TakeScreenshotAndSaveToFile File: vExceptionScreenshot ImageFormat: System.ImageFormat.Jpg
 File.WriteText File: $'''%varLogPath%\\%CurrentDateTime%.txt''' TextToWrite: vLogErrorDescription AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.Unicode
 WebAutomation.CloseWebBrowser BrowserInstance: Browser
 SET varIsSuccess TO $'''false'''
 Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''Execution Error''' Message: $'''An error occurred during flow execution. System has already send the error details to System Administrator.''' Icon: Display.Icon.ErrorIcon Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 10 ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed
END
"
